_comment: Config for .github/workflows/orchestrator.yml, read by .factory/scripts/run-agent.sh. Human-maintained -- agents are forbidden from editing .factory/** (except ambiguity-checklist.md), so this file is a safe place for orchestrator-only tuning. Check what each stage resolves to with: .factory/factory.sh config
label: build
_modelComment: harness: claude-code | opencode | codex. model: any OpenRouter slug from https://openrouter.ai/models (e.g. '~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest', '~google/gemini-flash-latest', 'openai/gpt-5.3-codex'). maxTurns: honored by claude-code only. maxAttempts: how many times a stage is re-run with the failing test output fed back (used by coder). Any key can be overridden per stage under 'stages'. Resolution order: workflow_dispatch override > stages.<stage>.<key> > top-level default.
_productComment: The product's own commands -- the only place the factory touches its stack (language, package manager, test runner). Run by .factory/scripts/product.sh with the factory's key material removed from the environment. setup: install toolchain + dependencies, start services (e.g. 'docker compose up -d'), migrate; runs before every agent stage. test: the suite; its exit status is the verdict. Keep it one command with no commas (it also becomes the agents' shell permission, e.g. Bash(pytest*)). testReport: the same suite, writing a JUnit XML report to $FACTORY_JUNIT, read by `factory red` (strictRedCheck). Test cases need a file attribute: pytest -o junit_family=xunit1, jest-junit JEST_JUNIT_ADD_FILE_ATTRIBUTE=true, gotestsum --junitfile, cargo nextest's JUnit output. env: extra environment variables for every product command. See README 'Plug in your product' for per-language examples.
_pathsComment: The factory/product boundary, decided by `factory paths` (the proved Lean gate, .factory/lean/Factory/PathGate.lean) via .factory/scripts/check-paths.sh after every agent stage and injected into each agent's prompt. Plain path prefixes, each ending in '/' (the gate refuses others). 'protected' wins over everything; any path not listed for a stage is off-limits to it, which includes the factory itself (.factory/, .github/).
_runKeyComment: Every build gets its own throwaway OpenRouter key, minted from your management key and deleted when the build ends. limitUsd caps what one build can spend (and what a leaked run key is worth); ttlMinutes is a backstop expiry in case deletion fails. The workflow clamps these to at most $50 / 360 min no matter what this file says.
_qaComment: strictRedCheck: when true, the QA job runs product.testReport and fails unless `factory red` accepts the JUnit report: some test in a file QA changed fails on an assertion, nothing errors at load/setup time, and no test outside QA's files fails. Works with any runner that writes JUnit XML. Set false to accept any red suite.
_versionsComment: Optional npm version pins per harness for reproducible runs, e.g. {"claude-code": "2.1.0"}. Unlisted harnesses install @latest.
